name: Cyber Cafe Owner
text: Theek hai, allotment form bhej do. Main print kar deta hoon.

name: you
text: Woh... mere paas abhi allotment form hai hi nahi.

name: Cyber Cafe Owner
text: Achha, toh pehle entrance quiz dena padega.

name: Cyber Cafe Owner
text: Haan. Entrance quiz mandatory hai. Quiz complete karoge tabhi allotment form milega.

name: you
text: Achha... kya main koi PC use karke quiz de sakta hoon?

name: Cyber Cafe Owner
text: Haan, bilkul. Opposite side mein beech wala PC chalu hai, wahi use kar lo.

name: you
text: Theek hai, quiz de deta hoon.

name: Cyber Cafe Owner
text: Quiz ke baad enrollment form fill kar lena. Uske baad allotment form ka kaam ho jayega.
